principles: Automation may orchestrate bounded Cybersecurity work but may not promote inference to primary evidence.
Cybersecurity primary evidence is never mirrored into Automation by the pair updater.
Git updates are clean-worktree and fast-forward-only.
Both projects are preflighted before either is promoted.
Partial paired Git promotion is rolled back when safe.
Every update emits a receipt and SHA-256 manifest.
Host validation is not physical Android validation.
